runs.q: How many games did Activision create?
runs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games WHERE publisher='Activision';
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM games WHERE year=2017 GROUP BY genre;

runs.q: Top game of 2016 by global sales?
runs.sql: SELECT name FROM games WHERE year=2016 ORDER BY globalsales DESC LIMIT 1;

runs.q: Ratio of sports sales America vs Japan?
runs.sql: SELECT SUM(americasales)/SUM(japansales) FROM games WHERE genre='Sports';
